description: Reported bug: Deep Striking a Custodian Guard with a Blade Champion attached let the player place the Custodian Guard's models but NEVER the Blade Champion — Main._begin_reinforcement_placement sized the placement session off the bodyguard's models alone (unlike DeploymentController.begin_deploy, which folds attached characters into a combined session), and MovementPhase then silently teleported the leader to first_bodyguard_model + 1" — usually straight on top of the squad, with none of the set-up rules validated against it. This drives the real player path: click the 'Arrive from Deep Strike: Custodian Guard + Blade Champion' reinforcement row, assert the session now covers all 4 models (3 guards + the champion) with the model-type picker offering 'Blade Champion x1', place the three guards by clicking the board, click the picker's Blade Champion button, click the board where the champion should stand, confirm with the real Confirm button, and assert the champion arrived AT THE CLICKED SPOT (not the old +1" auto-offset) and clear of every guard base.

steps.script:
# Put the Attached unit (Custodian Guard led by a Blade Champion) into Deep
# Strike reserves for battle round 2 — the same per-unit state FormationsPhase
# writes when the player declares them as reserves.
var gs = GameState.state
gs["meta"]["battle_round"] = 2
for uid in ["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B", "U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"]:
	gs.units[uid]["status"] = GameState.UnitStatus.IN_RESERVES
	gs.units[uid]["reserve_type"] = "deep_strike"
	for m in gs.units[uid]["models"]:
		m["position"] = null
gs.units["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"]["attached_to"] = "U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B"
gs.units["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B"]["attachment_data"] = {"attached_characters": ["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"]}
return "%d/%d" % [gs.units.U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B.status, gs.units.U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A.status]

steps.equals: Arrive from Deep Strike: Custodian Guard + Blade Champion|

steps.script:
# THE BUG: this used to be 3 (the Custodian Guard alone) so the Blade Champion
# could never be placed. It must now cover the whole Attached unit.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
return "total=%d combined=%s" % [dc.get_total_model_count(), str(dc.is_combined_deployment)]

# The leader is a distinct model type in the picker, so the player can choose
# when to place it.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var p = dc.model_type_picker_panel
if p == null or not is_instance_valid(p):
	return "NO_PICKER"
var labels = []
for key in p.type_buttons:
	labels.append(str(p.type_buttons[key].text))
labels.sort()
return ", ".join(labels)
steps.equals: Blade Champion x1, Custodian Guard x3

steps.script:
# The champion landed where the PLAYER clicked, not at the old
# first_guard_model + 1" auto-offset (which would have been 740,1200).
var p = GameState.get_unit("U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A").models[0].position
return "%.0f,%.0f" % [float(p.x), float(p.y)]

steps.equals: Custodian Guard + Blade Champion [YET TO MOVE]

steps.script: event_log_count_containing("Custodian Guard + Blade Champion arrived from Reserves (Deep Strike) (4 models)")
